review_basis.predecessor_gate: D090 coordinator gate accepted before D091

decision_rationale: The Java contract only reads the Python-owned integrity receipt. The historical versioned receipt and entire matching cache slice pass exact owner digest verification; no competing publisher or live data mutation was introduced.
limitations_reviewed: The stored receipt source_version differs from the current source/view fingerprint, so the current version has a cache miss and may be rebuilt by the Python owner on a later read.
The audit covers the latest stored receipt and its full 5,565-row slice, not all historical dates.
Java intentionally does not publish or repair coverage; human semantic review remains pending.
